create_keypoints_instance: create a Keypoints instance from a tensor of shape (N, K, 3) with x, y coordinates and visibility flags
build_keypoints_heatmap: build keypoint annotations into a heatmap using boxes and heatmap size for training labels
convert_heatmaps_to_keypoints: convert predicted heatmaps back to continuous keypoint coordinates with x, y, logit, and score
concatenate_keypoints_lists: concatenate a list of Keypoints objects into a single Keypoints tensor
index_keypoints_by_slice: index a Keypoints object by integer, slice, or boolean tensor to select subsets
